segments.title: A tomb NO ONE has opened
segments.say: This tomb has never been opened. It belongs to China's first emperor.

segments.title: The largest known tomb
segments.say: Its mound is about three hundred fifty meters on each side. Guinness lists it as the largest tomb of a known person.

segments.title: Lakes of mercury?
segments.say: Ancient accounts describe lakes of mercury inside, and booby-trapped crossbows.

segments.title: The soil backs it up
segments.say: And high mercury levels in the soil around it suggest that could be true.

segments.title: Scanned. Never opened.
segments.say: It has been scanned, but never opened or dug up.
